cv_reconstruction.normalizer: fit rows only within each fold; full applicable fit budget for refits
cv_reconstruction.selection_rule: maximum pooled held-fit-component official mean WP; exact ties choose larger alpha

advice: Treat R3 as an exposed F0 discovery panel: one whole sequence was sampled from each of 64 fit and 32 evaluation components, while other eligible groups within those components were not loaded. These official scores are realized-panel descriptions, not unbiased full-fold estimates; do not subtract R1/R2 scores because their sampling designs differ.

In this panel, fit-selected full64 scores put i1 addition near zero: books104 versus i0 is -0.000496 WP; raw112 versus i0+tail60 is -0.000044. At fixed alpha=1 the corresponding raw112 versus i0+tail60 delta is -0.001930. Tail additions are small positives in these contrasts. These are descriptive observations, not recipe improvement claims.

The selected signed-EMA view scores +0.010459 WP over raw112, while selected absolute-innovation and combined-EMA views are -0.004323 and -0.002560. The absolute view is strongly alpha-sensitive: its alpha1 outer delta is +0.029060 but the fit-selected alpha is 10000 and its selected delta is negative. This is a bounded sensitivity result, not evidence that a model learned a memory state or gradient mechanism.

Leave-one-component sensitivity is large relative to the feature contrasts. For selected raw112, the fixed-prediction WP shift spans -0.032709 to +0.025199 by omitted evaluation component; for selected signed EMA it spans -0.032349 to +0.017405. With only this exposed component panel, no significance or generalization claim is supported.

Nested32 raw112 and i0+tail60 differ from full64 by -0.026020 and -0.008446 WP, respectively, but nested32 changes both fitting size and component composition; it does not isolate a causal sample-size effect.
No outer evaluation metric influenced alpha selection; alpha is fit-only pooled CV over held fit components with a shared value for both targets and exact ties resolved toward larger alpha.

model_archive_metadata.source_writer_payload: np.savez numeric mean, scale, coefficient, intercept and norm arrays; no object payloads in the pinned writer

scope_limits: This audit read compact result/provenance JSON and small raw-moment arrays only. It did not load sample NPYs, open/re-hash NPZ archives, access remote data, rerun fitting, or rerun inference.
Raw moment reconstruction is at floating-point roundoff relative to the captured official metrics.
